---
title: "Interactive Workflow Survey"
page-layout: full
---

::: {.callout-note}
## Complete the workflow survey

1. Upload the merged flowchart SVG from `output/` and, if needed, choose a survey definition from `supplement/`.
2. Optionally upload the existing responses CSV from `output/`, then select **Build Survey Form**.
3. Click a survey-linked shape, enter your username and password, and submit your answers. Each submission is saved in this browser.
4. Download the updated CSV and commit it to your GitHub repository so the Decision Tool can use the responses.
:::

```{=html}
<style>

  .survey-choice { align-items: baseline; display: flex; gap: .4rem; margin: .35rem 0; }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {

<section class="survey-workspace">
  <div class="survey-card">
    <h2>Build the survey</h2>
    <div class="survey-upload-grid">
      <div>
        <label for="flowchart-upload">Merged flowchart SVG</label>
        <input id="flowchart-upload" type="file" accept=".svg,.drawio.svg,image/svg+xml">
        <small>Choose a merged `<filename>.drawio.svg` or `<filename>.svg` file from `output/`.</small>
      </div>
      <div>
        <label for="schema-upload">Survey schema JSON</label>
        <input id="schema-upload" type="file" accept=".json,application/json">
        <small id="schema-default-help">Default: `supplement/pam_si_2026.json`. Choose another schema to override it.</small>
      </div>
      <div>
        <label for="responses-upload">Existing responses CSV (optional)</label>
        <input id="responses-upload" type="file" accept=".csv,text/csv">
        <small>Choose a `<filename>_responses.csv` file from `output/` to pre-fill and retain prior responses.</small>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="survey-action-row">
      <button id="build-survey" type="button">Build Survey Form</button>
      <span id="build-status" class="survey-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="survey-app" hidden>
    <div class="survey-card">
      <h2 id="survey-heading">Workflow survey</h2>
      <p id="completion-count" class="survey-completion" aria-live="polite">Completed: 0 / 0 shapes</p>
      <div class="survey-controls" aria-label="Flowchart controls">
        <button id="zoom-in" type="button">🔍 Zoom In</button>
        <button id="zoom-out" type="button">🔍 Zoom Out</button>
        <button id="reset-view" type="button">⟲ Reset View</button>
        <span id="zoom-level">Zoom: 100%</span>

  </div>
  <div class="survey-card">

      <button id="submit-github-issue" type="button">Submit Workflow as GitHub Issue</button>
      <span id="submit-status" class="survey-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></span>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div id="survey-overlay" class="survey-overlay"></div>
<aside id="survey-sidebar" class="survey-sidebar" aria-label="Shape survey" aria-modal="true" role="dialog" aria-hidden="true">
  <button id="close-survey" class="survey-close" type="button" aria-label="Close survey">&times;</button>
  <h2 id="survey-title">Workflow Survey</h2>
  <p><strong>Shape:</strong> <span id="shape-info"></span></p>
  <div id="previous-entry-display"></div>
  <form id="survey-form">

      <input id="password" name="password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required>
      <small>Required to submit. Your password is not saved with the response.</small>

    <div id="dynamic-questions"></div>
    <button class="survey-submit" type="submit">Submit Response</button>

  </form>
</aside>

<div class="survey-location-card">
  <h2>Repository locations</h2>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>Flowchart SVG:</strong> <code id="flowchart-location">output/&lt;flowchart_base&gt;_&lt;survey_id&gt;.svg</code></li>
    <li><strong>Survey schema:</strong> <code id="schema-location">supplement/&lt;survey_id&gt;.json</code></li>
    <li><strong>Responses CSV:</strong> <code id="csv-location">output/&lt;flowchart_base&gt;_&lt;survey_id&gt;_responses.csv</code></li>
  </ul>
  <p>Commit your updated `_responses.csv` file to your GitHub repository so the Decision Tool can use the latest responses.</p>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const defaultSchemaPath = "../supplement/pam_si_2026.json";
  const coreHeaders = ["timestamp", "username", "shape_id", "shape_text"];
  const elements = Object.fromEntries([
    "flowchart-upload", "schema-upload", "responses-upload", "build-survey",
    "build-status", "survey-app", "survey-heading", "completion-count",
    "svg-viewer", "zoom-level", "download-csv", "response-count",
    "survey-overlay", "survey-sidebar", "survey-title", "shape-info",
    "previous-entry-display", "survey-form", "username", "password",
    "dynamic-questions", "form-message", "close-survey", "flowchart-location",
    "schema-location", "csv-location", "submitter-name", "submitter-email",
    "submitter-comments", "submit-github-issue", "submit-status"
  ].map(id => [id, document.getElementById(id)]));

  const state = {
    schema: null,
    flowchartBase: "",
    shapes: new Map(),
    importedResponses: [],
    responses: [],
    currentShape: null,
    svg: null,
    scale: 1,
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    dragging: false,
    startX: 0,
    startY: 0,
    completedNotificationShown: false
  };

  function setBuildStatus(message, isError = false) {
    elements["build-status"].textContent = message;
    elements["build-status"].classList.toggle("text-danger", isError);
  }

  function setSubmitStatus(message, isError = false) {
    elements["submit-status"].textContent = message;
    elements["submit-status"].classList.toggle("text-danger", isError);
  }

  function safeStem(filename) {
    return String(filename || "")
      .replace(/\.drawio\.svg$/i, "")
      .replace(/\.(?:svg|json|csv)$/i, "")
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g, "_")
      .replace(/^[_-]+|[_-]+$/g, "");
  }

  function csvEscape(value) {
    let text = value == null ? "" : Array.isArray(value) ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value);
    return `"${text.replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
  }

  function parseCSV(text) {
    const rows = [];
    let row = [];
    let field = "";
    let quoted = false;
    for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
      const character = text[index];
      if (quoted) {
        if (character === '"' && text[index + 1] === '"') {
          field += '"';
          index += 1;
        } else if (character === '"') {
          quoted = false;
        } else {
          field += character;
        }
      } else if (character === '"' && field.length === 0) {
        quoted = true;
      } else if (character === ",") {
        row.push(field);
        field = "";
      } else if (character === "\n" || character === "\r") {
        if (character === "\r" && text[index + 1] === "\n") index += 1;
        row.push(field);
        if (row.some(value => value !== "")) rows.push(row);
        row = [];
        field = "";
      } else {
        field += character;
      }
    }
    if (quoted) throw new Error("The uploaded CSV has an unclosed quoted field.");
    row.push(field);
    if (row.some(value => value !== "")) rows.push(row);
    if (rows.length < 2) return [];
    const headers = rows[0].map((header, index) => index === 0 ? header.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "") : header);
    return rows.slice(1).map(values => Object.fromEntries(
      headers.map((header, index) => [header, values[index] ?? ""])
    ));
  }

  function getQuestionHeaders() {
    return state.schema.questions.map(question => question.short_name);
  }

  function getResponses() {
    return [...state.importedResponses, ...state.responses];
  }

  function readStoredResponses() {
    try {
      const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(state.storageKey) || "[]");
      return Array.isArray(stored) ? stored : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  function persistResponse(response) {
    state.responses.push(response);
    localStorage.setItem(state.storageKey, JSON.stringify(state.responses));
    updateCompletion();
  }

  function mostRecentResponse(shapeId) {
    return getResponses()
      .filter(response => response.shape_id === shapeId)
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp) - new Date(a.timestamp))[0] || null;
  }

  function validateSchema(schema) {
    if (!schema || !schema.survey_metadata || !Array.isArray(schema.questions) || schema.questions.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("The JSON must contain survey_metadata and at least one question.");
    }
    const validTypes = new Set(["text", "single_choice", "multiple_choice", "yes_no"]);
    const names = new Set();
    schema.questions.forEach((question, index) => {
      if (!question.short_name || names.has(question.short_name)) {
        throw new Error(`Question ${index + 1} must have a unique short_name.`);
      }
      if (!validTypes.has(question.form_type)) {
        throw new Error(`Question "${question.short_name}" has an unsupported form_type.`);
      }
      if ((question.form_type === "single_choice" || question.form_type === "multiple_choice") &&
          (!Array.isArray(question.options) || question.options.length === 0)) {
        throw new Error(`Question "${question.short_name}" must define at least one option.`);
      }
      names.add(question.short_name);
    });
    return schema;
  }

  function parseSurveyLink(href) {
    const value = String(href || "");
    const marker = value.indexOf("#survey:");
    if (marker < 0) return null;
    const [shapeId, ...textParts] = value.slice(marker + 8).split("|");
    if (!shapeId) return null;
    return {shapeId, shapeText: textParts.join("|") || shapeId};
  }

  function parseXml(xmlText, description) {
    const parsed = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xmlText, "application/xml");
    if (parsed.querySelector("parsererror")) throw new Error(`Could not parse ${description} XML.`);
    return parsed;
  }

  async function decodeEmbeddedDiagram(svgDocument) {
    const svg = svgDocument.documentElement;
    const embedded = svg.getAttribute("content") ||
      svg.querySelector("metadata")?.textContent?.trim();
    if (!embedded) return null;
    const mxfile = parseXml(embedded, "embedded flowchart");
    const diagram = mxfile.querySelector("diagram");
    if (!diagram) return mxfile;
    const diagramText = diagram.textContent.trim();
    if (diagramText.startsWith("<")) return parseXml(diagramText, "embedded diagram");
    if (typeof DecompressionStream === "undefined") {
      throw new Error("This browser cannot unpack the compressed diagram XML in this SVG.");
    }
    const binary = Uint8Array.from(atob(diagramText), character => character.charCodeAt(0));
    const stream = new Blob([binary]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("deflate-raw"));
    const compressedText = new TextDecoder().decode(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
    let decodedText;
    try {
      decodedText = decodeURIComponent(compressedText);
    } catch {
      decodedText = compressedText;
    }
    return parseXml(decodedText, "embedded diagram");
  }

  function collectSurveyShapes(svgDocument, embeddedDocument) {
    const shapes = new Map();
    if (embeddedDocument) {
      embeddedDocument.querySelectorAll("[link]").forEach(cell => {
        const surveyLink = parseSurveyLink(cell.getAttribute("link"));
        if (!surveyLink) return;
        const label = cell.getAttribute("value") || cell.textContent.trim() || surveyLink.shapeText;
        shapes.set(surveyLink.shapeId, {shapeText: surveyLink.shapeText || label});
      });
    }
    svgDocument.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(anchor => {
      const href = anchor.getAttribute("href") || anchor.getAttributeNS("http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink", "href");
      const surveyLink = parseSurveyLink(href);
      if (!surveyLink) return;
      shapes.set(surveyLink.shapeId, {shapeText: surveyLink.shapeText});
    });
    return shapes;
  }

  function sanitizeSvg(svg) {
    svg.querySelectorAll("script, foreignObject").forEach(node => node.remove());
    svg.querySelectorAll("style").forEach(node => {
      if (/@import|url\s*\(\s*['"]?\s*(?:https?:|javascript:|data:|\/\/)/i.test(node.textContent)) {
        node.remove();
      }
    });
    [svg, ...svg.querySelectorAll("*")].forEach(node => {
      [...node.attributes].forEach(attribute => {
        const name = attribute.name.toLowerCase();
        const value = attribute.value.trim();
        if (name.startsWith("on")) {
          node.removeAttribute(attribute.name);
        } else if ((name === "href" || name.endsWith(":href")) &&
                   !value.includes("#survey:") && !value.startsWith("#")) {
          node.removeAttribute(attribute.name);
        } else if (name === "style" && /url\s*\(\s*['"]?\s*(?:https?:|javascript:|data:|\/\/)/i.test(value)) {
          node.removeAttribute(attribute.name);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function renderQuestion(question, index) {
    const field = document.createElement("section");
    field.className = "survey-question";
    field.dataset.questionIndex = String(index);
    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.textContent = question.label || question.short_name;
    field.append(label);
    if (question.description) {
      const description = document.createElement("small");
      description.textContent = question.description;
      field.append(description);
    }

    if (question.form_type === "text") {
      const textarea = document.createElement("textarea");
      textarea.rows = 3;
      textarea.dataset.answer = "text";
      field.append(textarea);
    } else {
      const options = question.form_type === "yes_no"
        ? [{label: "Yes", value: "yes"}, {label: "No", value: "no"}]
        : [...question.options];
      const isMultiple = question.form_type === "multiple_choice";
      if (question.allow_other && !isMultiple) {
        options.push({label: "Other", value: "__other__"});
      }
      const control = isMultiple ? document.createElement("div") : document.createElement("select");
      if (!isMultiple) {
        const empty = document.createElement("option");
        empty.value = "";
        empty.textContent = "-- Select --";
        control.append(empty);
      }
      options.forEach(option => {
        const optionLabel = typeof option === "string" ? option : option.label;
        const optionValue = typeof option === "string" ? option : option.value;
        if (isMultiple) {
          const choice = document.createElement("div");
          choice.className = "survey-choice";
          const input = document.createElement("input");
          input.type = "checkbox";
          input.value = optionValue;
          input.dataset.answer = "choice";
          const text = document.createElement("label");
          text.textContent = optionLabel;
          if (option.description) text.title = option.description;
          choice.append(input, text);
          control.append(choice);
        } else {
          const optionElement = document.createElement("option");
          optionElement.value = optionValue;
          optionElement.textContent = optionLabel;
          if (option.description) optionElement.title = option.description;
          control.append(optionElement);
        }
      });
      control.dataset.controlType = isMultiple ? "multiple" : "single";
      field.append(control);
    }

    if (question.allow_na) {
      const naChoice = document.createElement("div");
      naChoice.className = "survey-choice";
      const na = document.createElement("input");
      na.type = "checkbox";
      na.dataset.na = "true";
      const naLabel = document.createElement("label");
      naLabel.textContent = "Not applicable";
      naChoice.append(na, naLabel);
      field.append(naChoice);
    }
    if (question.allow_other && question.form_type !== "text") {
      const otherLabel = document.createElement("label");
      otherLabel.className = "survey-other";
      const other = document.createElement("input");
      other.type = question.form_type === "multiple_choice" ? "checkbox" : "text";
      other.dataset.other = "true";
      if (other.type === "text") {
        other.placeholder = "Other (please specify)";
        other.hidden = true;
        const select = field.querySelector("select");
        select.addEventListener("change", () => {
          other.hidden = select.value !== "__other__";
        });
        otherLabel.append(other);
        field.append(otherLabel);
      } else {
        other.value = "__other__";
        const otherText = document.createElement("span");
        otherText.textContent = "Other";
        otherLabel.append(other, otherText);
        const details = document.createElement("input");
        details.type = "text";
        details.dataset.otherText = "true";
        details.placeholder = "Please specify";
        details.hidden = true;
        field.append(otherLabel, details);
        other.addEventListener("change", () => { details.hidden = !other.checked; });
        return field;
      }
    }
    return field;
  }

  function answerFor(question, field) {
    if (field.querySelector("[data-na]")?.checked) return "N/A";
    if (question.form_type === "text") {
      return field.querySelector('[data-answer="text"]').value.trim();
    }
    if (question.form_type === "multiple_choice") {
      const answers = [...field.querySelectorAll('[data-answer="choice"]:checked')].map(input => input.value);
      const other = field.querySelector("[data-other]");
      const otherText = field.querySelector("[data-other-text]");
      if (other?.checked) {
        if (!otherText?.value.trim()) return [];
        answers.push(`Other: ${otherText.value.trim()}`);
      }
      return answers;
    }
    const select = field.querySelector("select");
    const other = field.querySelector("[data-other]");
    return select.value === "__other__" ? other.value.trim() : select.value;
  }

  function fillQuestion(question, field, value) {
    if (value == null || value === "") return;
    if (value === "N/A" && field.querySelector("[data-na]")) {
      field.querySelector("[data-na]").checked = true;
      return;
    }
    if (question.form_type === "text") {
      field.querySelector('[data-answer="text"]').value = value;
      return;
    }
    let values = value;
    if (typeof values === "string" && values.startsWith("[")) {
      try { values = JSON.parse(values); } catch { /* Keep legacy plain-text values. */ }
    }
    if (question.form_type === "multiple_choice") {
      const answers = Array.isArray(values) ? values : String(values).split("; ");
      answers.forEach(answer => {
        const choice = [...field.querySelectorAll('[data-answer="choice"]')].find(input => input.value === answer);
        if (choice) choice.checked = true;
        else if (String(answer).startsWith("Other: ")) {
          const other = field.querySelector("[data-other]");
          const details = field.querySelector("[data-other-text]");
          other.checked = true;
          details.hidden = false;
          details.value = String(answer).slice(7);
        }
      });
    } else if (String(values).startsWith("Other: ")) {
      const select = field.querySelector("select");
      select.value = "__other__";
      const other = field.querySelector("[data-other]");
      other.hidden = false;
      other.value = String(values).slice(7);
    } else {
      field.querySelector("select").value = values;
    }
  }

  function openSurvey(shapeId, shapeText) {
    state.currentShape = {shapeId, shapeText};
    elements["survey-sidebar"].classList.add("open");
    elements["survey-overlay"].classList.add("visible");
    elements["survey-sidebar"].setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    elements["survey-title"].textContent = state.schema.survey_metadata.survey_name || "Workflow Survey";
    elements["shape-info"].textContent = shapeText;
    elements["dynamic-questions"].replaceChildren(
      ...state.schema.questions.map(renderQuestion)
    );
    const previous = mostRecentResponse(shapeId);
    elements["previous-entry-display"].textContent = previous
      ? `Previous response from ${previous.username || "unknown user"} (${new Date(previous.timestamp).toLocaleString()}). Answers are pre-filled; submitting adds a new record.`
      : "No previous response for this shape.";
    elements["survey-form"].reset();
    elements["username"].value = previous?.username || "";
    state.schema.questions.forEach((question, index) => {
      const field = elements["dynamic-questions"].querySelector(`[data-question-index="${index}"]`);
      fillQuestion(question, field, previous?.[question.short_name]);
    });
    elements["form-message"].textContent = "";
    elements["form-message"].className = "survey-message";
    elements["username"].focus();
  }

  function closeSurvey() {
    elements["survey-sidebar"].classList.remove("open");
    elements["survey-overlay"].classList.remove("visible");
    elements["survey-sidebar"].setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    elements["survey-form"].reset();
    state.currentShape = null;
  }

  ["click", "focusin", "input", "change", "keypress", "keyup"].forEach(type => {
    elements["survey-sidebar"].addEventListener(type, event => event.stopPropagation());
  });
  elements["survey-sidebar"].addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.key !== "Escape") event.stopPropagation();
  });

  function updateResponseCount() {
    elements["response-count"].textContent = `Total records: ${getResponses().length}`;
  }

  function updateCompletion() {
    const responses = getResponses();
    const completed = [...state.shapes.keys()].filter(shapeId =>
      responses.some(response => response.shape_id === shapeId)
    );
    elements["completion-count"].textContent = `Completed: ${completed.length} / ${state.shapes.size} shapes`;
    if (state.svg) {
      state.svg.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(anchor => {
        const link = parseSurveyLink(
          anchor.getAttribute("href") || anchor.getAttributeNS("http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink", "href")
        );
        if (!link) return;
        anchor.classList.toggle("survey-shape-completed", completed.includes(link.shapeId));
        anchor.classList.toggle("survey-shape-incomplete", !completed.includes(link.shapeId));
      });
    }
    updateResponseCount();
    if (state.shapes.size > 0 && completed.length === state.shapes.size && !state.completedNotificationShown) {
      state.completedNotificationShown = true;
      setBuildStatus("🎉 All flowchart shapes are complete. Download the updated CSV to save your results.");
    }
  }

  function updateTransform() {
    if (!state.svg) return;
    state.svg.style.transform = `translate(${state.x}px, ${state.y}px) scale(${state.scale})`;
    elements["zoom-level"].textContent = `Zoom: ${Math.round(state.scale * 100)}%`;
  }

  async function buildSurvey() {
    const flowchartFile = elements["flowchart-upload"].files[0];
    const schemaFile = elements["schema-upload"].files[0];
    const responsesFile = elements["responses-upload"].files[0];
    if (!flowchartFile) throw new Error("Choose a merged flowchart SVG first.");
    setBuildStatus("Reading flowchart and survey files…");

    const [svgText, schemaText, responsesText] = await Promise.all([
      flowchartFile.text(),
      schemaFile ? schemaFile.text() : fetch(defaultSchemaPath).then(response => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not load the default PAM SI survey schema.");
        return response.text();
      }),
      responsesFile ? responsesFile.text() : Promise.resolve("")
    ]);
    const svgDocument = parseXml(svgText, "flowchart SVG");
    if (svgDocument.documentElement.localName !== "svg") throw new Error("The uploaded flowchart file is not an SVG.");
    const schema = validateSchema(JSON.parse(schemaText));
    const embeddedDocument = await decodeEmbeddedDiagram(svgDocument);
    const shapes = collectSurveyShapes(svgDocument, embeddedDocument);
    if (shapes.size === 0) throw new Error("No #survey: links were found in the SVG or its embedded diagram XML.");

    const importedResponses = responsesText ? parseCSV(responsesText) : [];
    const questions = schema.questions.map(question => question.short_name);
    const chartBase = safeStem(flowchartFile.name);
    const surveyId = safeStem(schema.survey_metadata.survey_id || "survey");
    if (!chartBase || !surveyId) throw new Error("Could not determine a valid flowchart filename or survey ID.");

    state.schema = schema;
    state.flowchartBase = chartBase;
    state.shapes = shapes;
    state.importedResponses = importedResponses;
    state.storageKey = `pam_workflow_survey_${chartBase}_${surveyId}`;
    state.responses = readStoredResponses();
    state.completedNotificationShown = false;

    const svg = svgDocument.documentElement;
    sanitizeSvg(svg);
    svg.removeAttribute("width");
    svg.removeAttribute("height");
    svg.style.maxWidth = "none";
    svg.style.maxHeight = "none";
    elements["svg-viewer"].replaceChildren(document.importNode(svg, true));
    state.svg = elements["svg-viewer"].querySelector("svg");
    state.svg.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(anchor => {
      const href = anchor.getAttribute("href") || anchor.getAttributeNS("http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink", "href");
      const surveyLink = parseSurveyLink(href);
      if (surveyLink) anchor.addEventListener("click", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        openSurvey(surveyLink.shapeId, surveyLink.shapeText);
      });
    });

    elements["survey-heading"].textContent = schema.survey_metadata.survey_name || "Workflow Survey";
    elements["flowchart-location"].textContent = `output/${chartBase}_${surveyId}.svg`;
    elements["schema-location"].textContent = `supplement/${surveyId}.json`;
    elements["csv-location"].textContent = `output/${chartBase}_${surveyId}_responses.csv`;
    elements["survey-app"].hidden = false;
    state.scale = 1;
    state.x = 0;
    state.y = 0;
    updateTransform();
    updateCompletion();
    setBuildStatus(`Survey ready: ${questions.length} questions and ${shapes.size} linked shapes.`);
  }

  function downloadBlob(blob, filename) {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = filename;
    document.body.append(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function surveyId() {
    return safeStem(state.schema.survey_metadata.survey_id || "survey");
  }

  function downloadCSV() {
    const headers = [...coreHeaders, ...getQuestionHeaders()];
    const rows = getResponses().map(response => headers.map(header => csvEscape(response[header])));
    const csv = [headers.map(csvEscape).join(","), ...rows.map(row => row.join(","))].join("\r\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csv], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"});
    downloadBlob(blob, `${state.flowchartBase}_${surveyId()}_responses.csv`);
  }

  function downloadSVG() {
    const svg = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(state.svg);
    const blob = new Blob([svg], {type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"});
    downloadBlob(blob, `${state.flowchartBase}_${surveyId()}.svg`);
  }

  function submitGitHubIssue() {
    const name = elements["submitter-name"].value.trim();
    const email = elements["submitter-email"].value.trim();
    const comments = elements["submitter-comments"].value.trim();
    if (!elements["submitter-name"].checkValidity() || !elements["submitter-email"].checkValidity()) {
      elements["submitter-name"].reportValidity();
      elements["submitter-email"].reportValidity();
      return;
    }
    if (!state.svg || !state.schema || !state.flowchartBase) {
      setSubmitStatus("Build the survey to create the flowchart SVG and responses CSV first.", true);
      return;
    }

    const baseName = `${state.flowchartBase}_${surveyId()}`;
    const body = [
      "## Workflow Submission Summary",
      "",
      `**Submitter Name:** ${name}`,
      `**Email Address:** ${email}`,
      ...(comments ? ["", `**Comments / Notes:** ${comments}`] : []),
      "",
      "---",
      "### Attached Files Checklist",
      "> Please drag and drop the downloaded `.svg` and `.csv` files into this issue box below before clicking **Submit new issue**:",
      `- [ ] \`${baseName}.svg\``,
      `- [ ] \`${baseName}_responses.csv\``
    ].join("\n");
    downloadSVG();
    downloadCSV();
    const issueUrl = new URL("https://github.com/nmfs-ost/PAM-workflows-template/issues/new");
    issueUrl.searchParams.set("title", `Workflow Submission: ${baseName} - ${name}`);
    issueUrl.searchParams.set("body", body);
    const issueTab = window.open(issueUrl, "_blank");
    if (issueTab) issueTab.opener = null;
    setSubmitStatus('Files downloaded! Please attach the downloaded .svg and .csv files into the newly opened GitHub Issue tab and click "Submit new issue".');
  }

  elements["build-survey"].addEventListener("click", async () => {
    try {
      await buildSurvey();
    } catch (error) {
      setBuildStatus(error.message || "Unable to build the survey.", true);
    }
  });

  elements["survey-form"].addEventListener("submit", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const username = elements["username"].value.trim();
    const password = elements["password"].value;
    if (!username || !password) {
      elements["form-message"].textContent = "Enter both a username and password before submitting.";
      elements["form-message"].className = "survey-message error";
      return;
    }
    const response = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, "Z"),
      username,
      shape_id: state.currentShape.shapeId,
      shape_text: state.currentShape.shapeText
    };
    for (const [index, question] of state.schema.questions.entries()) {
      const field = elements["dynamic-questions"].querySelector(`[data-question-index="${index}"]`);
      const answer = answerFor(question, field);
      if (answer.length === 0 || answer === "") {
        elements["form-message"].textContent = `Answer "${question.label || question.short_name}" or select Not applicable.`;
        elements["form-message"].className = "survey-message error";
        return;
      }
      response[question.short_name] = answer;
    }
    persistResponse(response);
    elements["password"].value = "";
    elements["form-message"].textContent = "Response saved in this browser. Submit again to add another response.";
    elements["form-message"].className = "survey-message success";
    closeSurvey();
  });

  elements["download-csv"].addEventListener("click", downloadCSV);
  elements["submit-github-issue"].addEventListener("click", submitGitHubIssue);
  elements["close-survey"].addEventListener("click", closeSurvey);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.key === "Escape" && elements["survey-sidebar"].classList.contains("open")) closeSurvey();
  });
  document.getElementById("zoom-in").addEventListener("click", () => {
    state.scale = Math.min(10, state.scale * 1.2);
    updateTransform();
  });
  document.getElementById("zoom-out").addEventListener("click", () => {
    state.scale = Math.max(.1, state.scale / 1.2);
    updateTransform();
  });
  document.getElementById("reset-view").addEventListener("click", () => {
    state.scale = 1;
    state.x = 0;
    state.y = 0;
    updateTransform();
  });

  elements["svg-viewer"].addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
    if (event.target.closest("a")) return;
    state.dragging = true;
    state.startX = event.clientX - state.x;
    state.startY = event.clientY - state.y;
    elements["svg-viewer"].setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  });
  elements["svg-viewer"].addEventListener("pointermove", event => {
    if (!state.dragging) return;
    state.x = event.clientX - state.startX;
    state.y = event.clientY - state.startY;
    updateTransform();
  });
  elements["svg-viewer"].addEventListener("pointerup", () => { state.dragging = false; });
  elements["svg-viewer"].addEventListener("wheel", event => {
    if (!state.svg) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    state.scale = Math.max(.1, Math.min(10, state.scale * (event.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : .9)));
    updateTransform();
  }, {passive: false});
})();
</script>
```
